title: Predicting the risk of threatened abortion using machine learning methods: a comparative study.
summary: A retrospective cohort contains 3,253 records; 1,764 threatened-abortion and 1,489 healthy cases were split into training, validation, and test sets.
ai_technology: Machine-learning methods predict threatened abortion from maternal clinical records.
organization: The Second Affiliated Hospital of Shaanxi University of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: A retrospective cohort contains 3,253 records; 1,764 threatened-abortion and 1,489 healthy cases were split into training, validation, and test sets. Single-center model study; reported discrimination is not a prospective intervention effect.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish performance or consequences beyond the reported cohort, datasets, task or experimental setup.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning methods predict threatened abortion from maternal clinical records.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
